_comment: ENF-1. `families` are the model.schema.json $defs whose every property is a tracked keyword `<def>.<property>`.
A keyword is WITNESSED by a probe naming it in its own `keywords` array (NPDevSamples/dsl-conformance-max/behavior-probes/*.json);
this file never repeats that. A keyword with no probe must sit in an `allowlist` group with a reason and an open ledger id.
frozenCount pins the number of allowlisted keywords: it may only shrink, and lowering it is part of the same commit as the probe that removes an entry.

ENF-2: a keyword that acts only at generation time (no booted-app effect) is witnessed by a `generationWitnesses` entry instead: a named JUnit testClass (repo-relative .java) plus the test `methods` that pin it; the checker verifies statically that the file and each @Test method exist and never runs Java.
Checked by scripts/quality/check-dsl-behavior-witness.py (aiKnowledge gate); the probes run in scripts/quality/run-behavior-probes.ps1.

generationWitnesses.reason: Generation-time only: it opts a specialization out of the npdev.lock version pin of its pack base (PackDependencyGraphWalker version-drift check). It has no effect on a booted app, so no REST probe can witness it; these tests run the real pack-merge pipeline and assert the default refuses on drift while the opt-in adopts the new parent shape.
